basic_info.description:
Location, location! This charming Richmond District unit is just one block from Golden Gate Park and within walking distance to Ocean Beach, the Legion of Honor, and a variety of local restaurants. Nestled in a peaceful 4-unit building, this bright and spacious two-level home offers a thoughtful layout and plenty of modern touches. The upper level features an open-concept living and dining area, a beautifully remodeled kitchen with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and ample cabinetry, plus two bedrooms and a stylishly updated full bath. Head downstairs to enjoy exclusive access to the garden, a second full bath, additional rooms perfect for guests or a home office, and a convenient wet bar.
The home boasts hardwood and tile flooring throughout, in-unit laundry, exclusive storage space in the common area, and an attached garage with two tandem parking spots.
Incredible location with easy access to public transportationdont miss this opportunity!
